2026-10-09JUSFederal Courts ActCommissioners for Administering Oaths ** Federal Courts **Order directing that Commissions do issue under the Great Seal of Canada empowering 6 officers of the Courts Administration Service to administer oaths and to take and receive affidavits, declarations and solemn affirmations, in or outside Canada, in or concerning any proceeding had or to be had in the Federal Court of Appeal or the Federal Court.N/A
subject: Commissioners for Administering Oaths ** Federal Courts **
precis: Order directing that Commissions do issue under the Great Seal of Canada empowering 6 officers of the Courts Administration Service to administer oaths and to take and receive affidavits, declarations and solemn affirmations, in or outside Canada, in or concerning any proceeding had or to be had in the Federal Court of Appeal or the Federal Court.
